facts: Maine is the only US state whose name consists of just one syllable.
Maine produces around ninety percent of the country's supply of wild blueberries.
Augusta is the easternmost state capital in the United States.
Acadia National Park is one of the most visited national parks in the country.
Maine is famous for its delicious lobsters harvested fresh along its extensive rocky coastline.
Author Stephen King was born in Maine and sets many of his famous novels there.
Maine has over four thousand islands scattered off its picturesque Atlantic coastline.
The northern terminus of the famous Appalachian Trail sits atop Mount Katahdin in Maine.
Olympic gold medalist Joan Benoit Samuelson, winner of the first women's Olympic marathon, is from Maine.
More than eighty percent of Maine's total land area is covered by lush forests.
Maine is the easternmost state in the contiguous United States.
Moosehead Lake is the largest mountain lake in the eastern United States.
Maine is renowned for its historic, picturesque lighthouses standing guard along the coast.
The official state dessert of Maine is the sweet and tangy blueberry pie.
Maine officially became the twenty-third state of the United States in 1820.
Fall foliage in Maine attracts visitors worldwide for its vibrant red, orange, and gold colors.
Maine has a rich tradition of wooden shipbuilding dating back to the colonial era.
The iconic duck boot was invented in Maine by outdoor retailer founder L.L. Bean.
